## Problem and purpose

What problem does this address, and why does it matter?

## Changes and resulting behavior

Separate existing behavior from new work. Include screenshots for visual changes.

## Related task, proposal and decision

Link the issue and planning/proposal ID. Is the scope approved, or is this a draft for review?

## Validation

List meaningful checks actually performed and results. Mark pending checks explicitly. Include versions, sources, limitations and reproducible evidence where relevant.

## Security, privacy and token impact

Does this affect supply, minting, authorities, treasury, fees, migration, governance, project-controlled wallets or official token identity? State the exact impact, even if none. Protected changes require explicit owner approval and additional review before acceptance.

## Breaking changes and recovery

Describe migration/recovery only if applicable to the software change; do not imply token migration or future-chain rights.

## Sources, licensing and assistance

Identify third-party material, reuse terms, dependency changes and material AI assistance.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR states what changed, why, and how it was checked.
- [ ] No wallet secrets, credentials or private records are included.
- [ ] No automatic trading, hidden economic controls or silent token changes are introduced.
- [ ] Future blockchain naming remains undecided (Zoora or AAI) unless a separate owner decision is linked.
- [ ] No migration, bridge, conversion, future-native-coin or financial-return promise is introduced.
- [ ] Protected-change decisions and additional review are linked, or explicitly not applicable.
- [ ] Status and limitations are accurate; merging source does not imply a deployed service.

A checklist is a review aid, not a substitute for evidence or required approval.
